Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The players are out in the middle. Finn Allen and Devon Conway to start. Bhuvneshwar Kumar to bowl first. Two slips in place.
...The Chase...

New Zealand bowlers were beaten by the class of Suryakumar. To be honest, they bowled well but failed to keep Suryakumar quiet. Suryakumar might take all the credit but not forget the last over from Tim Southee. He ended with a Hat-trick and gave away just 5 runs in the final over. That could possibly make a huge impact on the game. The other bowlers were taken to the cleaners. Right then, clearly, this is an above-par score and New Zealand have to come up big in the chase. An interesting chase is coming your way. Stay tuned.

Suryakumar Yadav is up for a chat. He says a century in T20I is always special. Adds Pandya told him to take the game deep and the idea was to maximize in the back end. Reckons he is enjoying batting at the moment. Rishabh Pant cheekily comes from behind and gives a tight hug to Suryakumar.

The star of the show - Suryakumar Yadav, what a special, special player. A treat to watch. We felt 180 will be a par total but an excellent finish mostly from Suryakumar has helped them end with 191. The pitch was not easy to bat on and India struggled early on. After the rain delay, India played with intent, mostly Suryakumar Yadav as he played some extraordinary shots and paced his innings brilliantly. The sky was dark but SKY below lit up the show.

Suryakumar Yadav saw the last over from the other end as Tim Southee took all the credit and ended with a Hat-trick but the damage was done earlier from SKY as he brought up his second century. What a player. What a knock from the No.1 T20I batter in the world.
Length ball, outside off, Kumar pushes it through point for one.

OUT! HAT-TRICK FOR TIM SOUTHEE! His second in T20I! What an over from him. A length ball, outside off. Washington Sundar swings his bat but without much conviction and James Neesham from long on runs in and takes the catch. Smiles all-around. New Zealand players celebrate as they gather around Tim Southee.
Commentary.Howout: c James Neesham b Tim Southee

Commentary.Commentary: Washington Sundar to face the Hat-trick ball.

OUT! CAUGHT! On a length and on middle. Hooda whips but straight to short fine leg where Lockie Ferguson takes a very sharp catch. Suryakumar Yadav will be itching to get back on the strike. Fun banter between him and Tim Southee goes on.
Commentary.Howout: c Lockie Ferguson b Tim Southee

Commentary.Commentary: Deepak Hooda walks out.
OUT! TAKEN! The new batter will be on the strike. On a length and outside off. Pandya tries to power it down the ground but fails and James Neesham at long off takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c James Neesham b Tim Southee

Commentary.Commentary: Full ball, slower and on middle. Pandya looks to heave but gets a top edge but the ball falls safely to deep mid-wicket. Two more.
Length ball, outside off. Pandya pulls it to deep mid-wicket. The fielder dives to his left and parries it to the man running from long on. Good work. Two runs.
SIX! Lockie Ferguson just doesn't know what to do at the moment. 22 runs off the over! 4,0,4,4,4,6. What an over for India. Short and outside off. Suryakumar upper-cuts it over third man for a six.
FOUR! There are all types of shots under his belt. Short and on middle. Suryakumar ramps it over the keeper for a boundary.

HUNDRED FOR SURYAKUMAR! Brilliant, extraordinary and just outstanding. Name a better player than him right now. He is just too good. His second century. Full ball, outside off. Suryakumar drives on the up and over cover for a boundary.
FOUR! SURYAKUMAR ON 97! Short, slow and outside off. Suryakumar cuts but splices it over point for a biggie.
A length ball on off. Suryakumar shuffles across as he looks to flick but misses. Might have got an inside edge. An appeal for LBW but not given.

FOUR! This is not luck, this is just Suryakumar showing off his class. Lockie Ferguson goes full and outside off. Suryakumar drives, it goes more off the outside edge over short third man for a boundary.
Fuller ball, outside off. Suryakumar drives it to deep cover for a single. 18 off the over. 35 off the last two.
SIX! Add this to Suryakumar's extraordinary shots locker! Short ball on middle. Suryakumar stands tall and hammers it over fine leg for a biggie.
This time fails to get the distance! This is full, slow and outside off. Suryakumar lofts it over mid off, gets more height and enough to land it safely. Two more.
On the pads, whacks it to deep square leg for a couple.
SIX! He is just too good! A half-volley, around off. Suryakumar takes a step back and lofts it over long off for a six.
Short and around off. Pandya hoicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, outside off. Pandya knocks it to sweeper cover for one. 17 runs off it then.
On middle, this is eased to long on for a single.
FOUR! Suryakumar has an answer to every ball at the moment! Short and outside off. Suryakumar opens the face of the bat and places it over backward point for one more boundary.
On a length and around off. Suryakumar keeps it out.
Wide! Pressure on Southee! This is down the leg side. Suryakumar misses his flick.
FOUR! Past the fielder! This is full and on the pads. Suryakumar whips it to deep square leg. Daryl Mitchell runs to his right but fails to stop it.
SIX! Good start to the over! Brilliant! This is full and outside off. Suryakumar steps across and heaves it over cow corner for a biggie.
Quicker ball on the pads, flicked to deep square leg for one. 10 runs off the over. 180 looks possible from here on.
SIX! Wonderful shot again! Tossed up on middle. Suryakumar reaches to the pitch of the ball, opens the off side and lofts it over covers for a six.
Flatter ball, outside off, Suryakumar cuts but finds point.
Outside off, punched to covers for a single.
Fifty for Suryakumar! Yet another fifty for the No.1 T20I batter in the world! On middle, Suryakumar plays it to long on for a single. A big finish is needed now.
Flatter and on middle, this is hit to long on for a single.
A juicy half-volley, on off. Pandya eases it to long on for a single.
Very full and outside off. Pandya tries to get underneath of the ball but fails to hit it cleanly.
Length and on middle. Suryakumar chips it in the air to square leg for a single.
Full ball, outside off. Suryakumar pushes it to cover.
Fuller ball, outside off, slower delivery. Suryakumar drives and misses.
A full toss on middle. Pandya punches it straight down. The umpire shows good reflexes as he strides away quickly. It rolls to long on for one.
Around off, kept out. Just 6 off the over!
Sodhi anticipates and serves it way outside off. Suryakumar swings his bat but rolls fine back to the keeper.
Short and outside off. Suryakumar cuts it to point.

FOUR! Action replay from Suryakumar! He has played thrice this shot now and perfected again this time! This is full and on middle. Suryakumar plays the inside-out shot over covers and it races into the fence.
On middle, on the fuller side. Pandya drives it to long off for one.
Tossed up, outside off. Suryakumar punches it past cover for a single.
Full ball, outside off. Pandya drives it through covers for two runs.
A sharp bouncer and on middle. Pandya lets it go.

OUT! HIT WICKET! What has happened there? Ohh, dear! Shreyas Iyer has just dragged himself! Short in length and on middle. Iyer goes way back in his crease as he flicks it to square leg but his back leg touches the stumps and lights up. An unfortunate way to get out.
Length and on middle, Suryakumar taps it to point for one.
SIX! WOW! Suryakumar, you beauty. Short in length and on the hips. Suryakumar stands tall, whacks it behind square leg for a biggie.
FOUR! What a shot! Suryakumar at his best! A full toss from Lockie, outside off. Suryakumar drives it past covers for a boundary.
Angled on the pads. Suryakumar whips it past square leg for one. 15 off the over. India motoring along.
Flatter and on middle, it is drilled to long on for a single.
SIX! 13 off the over so far! Superb from these two now! not letting Sodhi to settle in. Floated, full and outside off. Iyer shuffles across and smacks it over long off for a six.
Flatter and angling on the pads, it is clipped to square leg for a single.
On middle, Suryakumar again goes inside-out but this time the fielder from long off cuts it off. Two runs.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Tossed up on middle. Suryakumar goes inside-out over covers for a boundary.
An arm ball, on middle, it is hit right to the bowler. Good stop from Santner as he stretches his leg.
Flighted, full and outside off. Iyer lets it go.
Flatter and on middle, Suryakumar punches it to long on for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off, it is pushed to long off for a single.
Full and outside off. Suryakumar inside edges his drive to square leg for a single.
FOUR! Both the batters are now playing with intent. Very full and outside off. Suryakumar drives it square on the off side for a boundary.
On middle, it is hit to long on for a single.
This is full and outside off, it is driven to point.
Floated, around off, slower ball. Iyer scoops it behind the keeper for one more.
Short and outside off. Iyer looks to cut but misses.
FOUR! Some start from Iyer! Pitched up on middle. Iyer powers it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Shreyas Iyer comes in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Kishan goes now. Short, quicker and just outside off. Kishan rocks on the back foot to play the cut shot but the ball is too close to him. He gets an outside edge and the ball flies to short third man where Tim Southee dives forward and catches it.
Commentary.Howout: c Tim Southee b Ish Sodhi

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! He just loves to play that shot! Tossed up, outside off. Suryakumar gets his front foot across and slogs it behind square on the leg side for a biggie. The last ball ruins a good over from Mitchell Santner,
Tossed up on off. Kishan clips it to deep mid-wicket for one.
This is good bowling from Santner! Shorter, quicker and outside off. Kishan keeps it out.
On the pads. Suryakumar works it to deep mid-wicket for one more.
Outside off, whipped to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and on leg. Suryakumar flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Sees Kishan coming down the track and bowls a flat, quicker ball. Kishan gets an outside edge and the ball lobs in front of backward point.
FOUR! Smacked! Very full and outside off. Kishan thumps it down the ground to the long off fence.
Quicker ball on middle, Suryakumar plays it to long on for one.
Touch short and on middle. Suryakumar pulls it in the gap to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
On middle, swept to deep square leg for a single.

Excellent review from Kishan! That was close though. Sodhi starts with a googly, flatter and around off. Kishan prods to defend but the ball goes through the open gate and hits him on the back leg. An appeal for LBW and up goes the finger. Ishan Kishan takes the review straightaway. UltraEdge shows no bat. Ball Tracking shows the wickets are missing. Kishan survives.
Ish Sodhi to bowl now.
Length and on off, jags back in. Suryakumar tucks it to square leg.
This is full and on middle. Kishan lofts it to long on for one.
Resumption! The players are out in the middle. James Neesham to continue with his over. 36 minutes of play lost, no overs lost.
Update - 1252 IST (0722 GMT) - Good news! It has stopped raining. The play should start anytime soon. The covers are still on though.

Update - 1236 IST (0706 GMT) - The umpires are calling for the covers as the intensity of the rain has increased. The covers are coming on. VVS Laxman is seen having a chat with the umpire. Stay tuned for further updates.
Again on a length and outside off. Kishan has a poke at it but misses.
A good length delivery, outside off. Kishan has a wild swing across but misses.
FOUR! Two in a row! James Neesham changes the angle as he comes around the wicket with a short ball. Kishan pulls it behind square on the leg side for four more.
It has started to drizzle.
FOUR! Crunched! A length ball, way outside off. Kishan smashes it, over point and to the fence.
James Neesham to bowl now.
Very full and outside off, it is driven to cover. At the end of the Powerplay, India are 42 for 1.

FOUR! Just eludes the fielder! This is on a length and around off. Suryakumar steps across and laps it over the keeper, didn't middle this time. Tim Southee from first slip runs back and leaps but the ball lobs over him and races to the fence.
This is full and outside off, much closer to the off pole. Suryakumar looks to drive but misses again.
A length ball, outside off, this one straightens off the deck. Not much movement. Suryakumar looks to push but misses.
A length ball, outside off. Suryakumar guides it through point for a couple of runs.

OUT! TAKEN! Excellent catch from Southee and New Zealand find the breakthrough. This is short and Pant goes for the pull but this is way outside off. Pant is not fully in control of the shot and ends up getting a top edge. The ball goes over short third man where Tim Southee runs back and takes a wonderful catch over his head. Safe pair of hands.
Commentary.Howout: c Tim Southee b Lockie Ferguson

Commentary.Commentary: Slants a length ball on middle. Pant drops it to point for a quick single. Just 6 off the over. New Zealand will be happy with the start.
Outside off. Pant taps it to point.
On a length and on middle. Kishan nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! This time finds the gap! Adam Milne is still not able to find that length. He serves a full toss now, outside off. Kishan drives it through covers, right of mid off for a boundary.
Short in length, outside off. Kishan smashes it to mid off but again finds the fielder.
A full toss on middle. Kishan pushes it straight to mid off.
Follows Kishan on the leg side with a full ball, this is hit to mid on for a single.
Bangs a bouncer now, around middle. Good pace from Lockie Ferguson and Kishan fails to pull it away.
Leg bye! On the pads. This one rolls off the pads of Pant to short fine leg for a single.

Overthrow! Outside off. Kishan guides it to short third man. He wants a single but is sent back. The fielder has a shy at the batter's end but misses. The back up fielder fails to collect the ball cleanly and the batters eventually get a single.
On a length and outside off. Kishan dabs it to backward point.
SIX! Played so effortlessly. On a length and on the pads. Kishan plays the pick up shot. It was in the air for a while but cleared the mid-wicket fence with ease. First six of the match.
Leg bye! Angles it onto the pads. Kishan misses his clip and it rolls off the pads to short fine leg for a leg bye.
Full ball, outside off. Pant swings his bat, gets an inside edge to short fine leg for one.
Length ball from around the wicket. Pant pushes it straight to cover. Kishan was off his line and Mitchell Santner has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
A length ball, outside off. Pant punches it to covers now.
Outside off, Kishan drives it to deep point for one more.
FOUR! Played it really late! A length ball, around off. Kishan waits for the ball to arrive, opens the face of the bat in the last moment and places it to third man for a boundary.
Hit hard but finds the fielder! On a length and outside off. Pant slaps it to cover-point.
Wide! One more! Full ball, going down the leg side. Pant fails to swipe this away. Wided.
Big swing and a miss! Good idea but Pant fails to execute it. This is very full and around middle and leg. Pant wants to heave this over mid-wicket but only gets an inside edge onto the pads.
On the pads, Pant flicks it straight to mid-wicket.
Wide! Milne not able to find his correct line. This is again down the leg side. Pant misses his nudge.
Outside off on a length. Pant knocks it to point.
Five wides! A loosener from Milne! He tries to swing this back in but ends up serving it way down the leg side. No chance for the keeper to stop and the ball races to the fine leg fence.
This is full and on leg. Kishan makes room and eases it to mid on for a quick single.
Angles a full ball away from the left-hander. Kishan leaves it.
Adam Milne to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! Pant is off the mark in style! Southee pitches it up, around off. Pant stays back and whacks it past the diving mid on fielder for a boundary.
Lovely delivery! A length ball, around off and this one seams away at the very last moment. It is delivered at 132.9 kph. Pant is drawn forward to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Kishan is off the mark! A length ball, around off. Kishan plays with an open bat-face to third man for a single.
A length ball, outside off, this one nips back in after landing outside off. Kishan dabs it to backward point.
Short in length, outside off. Kishan feels for it but fails to connect his bat on it.
Wide! India are underway! Fuller ball and this one shapes away but the line is down the leg side. Kishan misses his flick.
Starts with a beautiful inswinger, full and around off. Kishan pushes it gently to mid off.
So, Ishan Kishan will open alongside Rishabh Pant. Kishan walks out with two right-hand gloves and has to rush back. Tim Southee to start with the ball. Here we go...
We are all set for the action. The players line up for the respective national anthems. It will be India's first followed by New Zealand's.

India (Playing XI) - Ishan Kishan, Rishabh Pant (WK), Suryakumar Yadav, Shreyas Iyer, Deepak Hooda, Hardik Pandya (C), Washington Sundar, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Arshdeep Singh, Mohammed Siraj, Yuzvendra Chahal.
New Zealand (Playing XI) - Finn Allen, Devon Conway (WK), Kane Williamson (C), Glenn Phillips, Daryl Mitchell, James Neesham, Mitchell Santner, Ish Sodhi, Tim Southee, Adam Milne, Lockie Ferguson.

Hardik Pandya, the captain of India says it is good to get a game and the guys are excited. States they need to assess the conditions and see how the wicket plays and play accordingly. Adds pace and bounce now doesn't matter and you need to cope with it.

Kane Williamson, the skipper of New Zealand says the wicket has been under cover and there is also weather around and that is why they want to bowl. Informs Adam Milne comes in. States they might experiment a little and they are looking forward to this series. Adds playing against India is a great occasion and he hopes his side can do well.
TOSS - New Zealand have won the toss and they will BOWL first!

Umran Malik is up for a chat. He says it is a proud moment to play for India. Mentions he is working on his lengths and practicing different deliveries. Reckons he will keep bowling fast but will also include variations more. Says they have to adapt to the conditions well.
PITCH REPORT - The pitch looks dry and has extra grass on it, giving extra grip for the spinners. The pitch might stay the same and the captain will look to bat first on this pitch.

After the premature exit from the World Cup, both teams are looking for a fresh start. India are likely to hand over the T20I reigns in Pandya’s hands for long term. New Zealand though are sticking with Kane Williamson and will look to get the series underway with a win but as said earlier, let’s hope the rain gods don’t play a big part again. Stay tuned.

Hello and welcome to the second T20I between India and New Zealand. First thing first, talking about the weather and the forecast is same as what we saw as Wellington. We have already lost one game due to rain and the conditions here at Mount Maunganui is not so good. Let’s be optimistic and hope we get some action.
...Match Day...
